body:
Fixes #2088.

## The problem

The #2084 preflight measured the right thing and then walked past the answer.
From the failing `solve v2.8.7` run
(`docs/case-studies/issue-2088/raw/solution-draft-log-pr-1784536731842.txt`),
four lines ten milliseconds apart:

```
08:36:11.407  Model-visible skills (5): imagegen, openai-docs, plugin-creator, skill-creator, skill-installer
08:36:11.411  Codex capability preflight skipped
08:36:11.415  Continuing with the operator Codex capabilities
08:36:11.420  codex exec …
```

The gap was detected, named, and ignored. The repair step could never fire
because it skipped `plugin add` whenever `codex plugin list` reported the plugin
`installed, enabled` — and enablement (`config.toml`) is independent of exposure
(the materialized payload under
`plugins/cache/<marketplace>/<plugin>/<version>/skills`). Nothing in the Codex
CLI reconciles the two.

## Reproduction (real Codex CLI 0.144.6)

`experiments/issue-2088/reproduce-cache-repair.sh`, captured in
`docs/case-studies/issue-2088/raw/experiment-cache-repair.log`:

```
healthy                       → 14 superpowers skills exposed
skills/ subtree removed       → codex plugin list: installed, enabled
                                codex debug prompt-input: 0 superpowers skills
codex plugin add <id>         → 14 skills again
```

Installed, enabled, and invisible — simultaneously. That is the exact production
signature, and it is why `plugin list` cannot be the success signal.

## The fix

`src/codex-capability-preflight.lib.mjs` now:

1. inspects the scoped `plugins/cache` payload directly instead of trusting
   `plugin list`;
2. repairs it through an escalating ladder — `install` → `reinstall`
   (remove + purge cache + add) → `copy-operator-payload` (for a scoped home
   that cannot reach its marketplace);
3. re-probes `codex debug prompt-input` in the exact environment `codex exec`
   receives, and forces one rebuild when a required skill is still invisible;
4. **fails closed before `codex exec`** when an explicitly declared plugin or
   `plugin:skill` requirement cannot be made visible, with a diagnostic naming
   the missing skills, the expected cache path, the scoped home and every repair
   attempted.

Heuristically inferred requirements (bare `$name`, `` `name` skill ``) still
degrade rather than block, preserving #2077's false-positive protection.
`HIVE_MIND_CODEX_CAPABILITY_ADVISORY=1` opts out of fail-closed;
`HIVE_MIND_CODEX_CAPABILITY_STRICT=1` (#2084) still hard-fails everything.

## Claude Code

Per the issue comment ("We must have similar mechanism for Claude if needed"),
Claude Code was checked against the real CLI 2.1.215
(`experiments/issue-2088/reproduce-claude-cache-gap.sh`): identical cache layout,
identical enabled-vs-materialized split, `plugin list --json` reports
`enabled: true` with a non-existent `installPath`. The inspection and repair
logic therefore moved into a CLI-agnostic `src/agent-plugin-cache.lib.mjs`
parameterized by `CODEX_PLUGIN_CLI` / `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_CLI`, and is tested against
both. No Claude *provisioning* path is added — Hive Mind installs no Claude
plugins today, Claude provisioning is an explicit non-goal of the issue, and
Claude Code has no `debug prompt-input` equivalent to verify against. Rationale
in `docs/case-studies/issue-2088/requirements.md` R9.

## Upstream issues filed

Both CLIs misreport this state, so both were reported with a reproduction, the
workaround used here, and three suggested fixes each:

- openai/codex#34321 — `plugin list` reports `installed, enabled` for an absent payload
- anthropics/claude-code#79384 — `plugin list --json` reports `enabled: true` with a non-existent `installPath`

## Tests

`tests/test-issue-2088-codex-plugin-cache-repair.mjs` (new) — the acceptance
criteria, section by section: alias normalization (`@openai-curated-remote`),
missing cache, repeated execution is idempotent, stale cache (version directory
with no `skills/`), unreachable marketplace → operator payload fallback,
unrepairable explicit requirement fails closed with no `codex exec`, heuristic
requirement still degrades, repository isolation.

`tests/test-issue-2088-agent-plugin-cache.mjs` (new) — the shared primitive
against both CLI descriptors: cache path, health verdicts, repair through each
CLI's own verbs, idempotence, escalation, unrepairable reporting.

The full `default` suite passes; #2077, #2080 and #2084 suites are unchanged and
green.

## Case study

`docs/case-studies/issue-2088/` — `README.md`, `timeline.md`, `analysis.md`,
`requirements.md` (every requirement with its status and evidence), `research.md`
(upstream mechanics, related issues, existing-component survey), plus `data/`
and `raw/`.
title: fix(2088): repair the repository-scoped Codex plugin cache before codex exec
